 Expecting a Refund but Owe Back Taxes? Clear Start Tax Explains How the IRS Offset Program Takes It First 
 ACCESS Newswire 
 Nov 16, 2026 
 11 hrs ago 
 1 min to read 
 Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... 
 A refund is not paid to a taxpayer who owes. It is applied, automatically, before anyone is asked.
 IRVINE, CA / ACCESS Newswire / November 16, 2026 / Taxpayers carrying a balance from prior years often plan around an expected refund. Clear Start Tax says that plan tends to fail in a specific and avoidable way: the refund never arrives, because it was applied to the older debt before anyone was consulted.
